description:
The Maven goals that bind governance checks and explicit repair operations to the build. Checks
        are read-only. Repair goals run only when called directly.

        A check that shipped as a test could be accidentally deselected by -Dtest=OneClass. As goals the
        checks stay bound to their phases, their parameters are named and typed, and a failure names the
        check in the line that reports it. Every check and writing goal explicitly honors -DskipTests as
        the quality and governance bypass.
